description: A legacy Windows POS of the kind long installed in Lebanese restaurants: French labels in Windows-1252 (ESC t 16), 'Facture N°', 'Couverts', Qté / Désignation / P.U. / Montant columns, LBP amounts with comma thousands, the total in double width, VAT shown as included ('dont TVA 11%') and a second total in USD. Modelled on typical layouts; not yet checked against a real capture.
